Sampled examples such as C0204920 (Z09 follow-up), C0205690 and C0206083 (J06.9 upper respiratory infection) and C0205584 (M54.50 low back pain) are presentations that rarely support high-complexity decision making. That said, the high-complexity samples (for example C0205190 and C0206327) look plausibly appropriate, and the documentation is too thin to judge: only 16 charts returned, all billed 99214, and none billed 99215. The 2 of 16 99214 notes documented below the billed level (C0204835, C0205104) and the 2 moderate-or-higher data-reviewed notes with no lab or test line on the claim are weak signals worth noting, not proof. The reviewer's first step should be a targeted records request for 99215 claims on low-complexity patients, starting with the sampled 0-condition visits, to test whether MDM or time supports the billed level."}
